cases.name: health-check guidance
cases.actual: Send GET /health and confirm that status is ok.
cases.reference: Use GET /health and expect status ok.

cases.name: safe authentication guidance
cases.actual: Pass the token in the Authorization: Bearer header. Do not log or commit it.
cases.reference: Use an Authorization Bearer header and do not expose the secret in logs.

cases.name: loopback deployment guidance
cases.actual: Keep the service on the loopback address 127.0.0.1:8642.
cases.reference: Bind the gateway only to loopback at 127.0.0.1:8642.
